creative_direction: Show one peacock feather translated into a handcrafted wood-and-lacquer inlay. The central shaft is pale maple, the long barbs alternate between walnut and deep black lacquer, and the eye of the feather uses blue-green mother-of-pearl pieces. Place the feather diagonally but keep its broad upper portion centered on a muted warm-gray ground. Render fine wood grain, polished lacquer depth, and restrained pearlescent shifts that change across the shell pieces. The feather outline should stay elegant and clearly defined, with a few narrow gaps between barbs. No jewelry fittings, lettering, or ornamental border. Treat it as a precise original craft object photographed under soft directional light.
